note: Year 11 Higher Higher Spring Block 3 Rates: one set of templates per small step of the White Rose Maths scheme of learning.

templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S1 Distance-time graphs
templates.text: A cyclist rides at [[v]] km/h. How far does she go in [[t]] hours? Write the point to plot on a distance-time graph.

templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S1 Distance-time graphs
templates.text: A walker travels [[d1]] km in [[t1]] hours and then stops for [[g]] hour[[g > 1|if:s/]]. Write the three points that join to show this journey, starting at (0, 0).

templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S1 Distance-time graphs
templates.text: A car travels [[d1]] km in [[t1]] hours, stops for [[g]] hour and then travels a further [[d2]] km in [[t2]] hours. Write the coordinates of the end of each section of the graph.

templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S1 Distance-time graphs
templates.text: Draw a distance-time graph for this journey. A person walks at [[v1]] km/h for [[t1]] hours, rests for [[g]] hour and then walks back to the start at [[v1]] km/h. Write the coordinates you would plot and the total time. (3 marks)

templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S2 Velocity-time graphs
templates.text: A velocity-time graph is a horizontal line at [[v]] m/s for [[t]] s. What is the acceleration?

templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S2 Velocity-time graphs
templates.text: A car speeds up from 0 to [[v]] m/s in [[t]] s at a constant rate. Find the acceleration.

templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S2 Velocity-time graphs
templates.text: On a velocity-time graph the line goes from ([[t1]], [[v1]]) to ([[t2]], [[v2]]). Work out the acceleration.

templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S2 Velocity-time graphs
templates.text: A train decelerates from [[v]] m/s to rest in [[t]] s. Find the deceleration and the distance travelled (constant deceleration). (3 marks)
templates.answer: Deceleration [[v / t|dp:2]] m/s²; distance [[v * t / 2|dp:1]] m

templates.subtopic: Acceleration and area under a velocity-time graph
templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S3 Acceleration and area under a velocity-time graph
templates.text: A velocity-time graph is a horizontal line at [[v]] m/s for [[t]] s. Find the distance travelled.

templates.subtopic: Acceleration and area under a velocity-time graph
templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S3 Acceleration and area under a velocity-time graph
templates.text: A velocity-time graph is a triangle with base [[t]] s and height [[v]] m/s. Find the distance travelled.

templates.subtopic: Acceleration and area under a velocity-time graph
templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S3 Acceleration and area under a velocity-time graph
templates.text: A car accelerates from 0 to [[v]] m/s in [[t1]] s, then travels at [[v]] m/s for [[t2]] s. Find the total distance.

templates.subtopic: Acceleration and area under a velocity-time graph
templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S3 Acceleration and area under a velocity-time graph
templates.text: A cyclist accelerates from rest to [[v]] m/s in [[t1]] s, holds that speed for [[t2]] s then slows to rest in [[t3]] s. Find the total distance and average speed (1 d.p.). (4 marks)
templates.answer: Distance [[v * (t1 + t3) / 2 + v * t2|dp:1]] m; average speed [[(v * (t1 + t3) / 2 + v * t2) / (t1 + t2 + t3)|dp:1]] m/s

templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S4 Compound units, density and pressure
templates.text: A metal block has mass [[d * v]] g and volume [[v]] cm³. Work out its density.

templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S4 Compound units, density and pressure
templates.text: A force of [[F]] N acts on an area of [[A]] m². Work out the pressure in N/m².

templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S4 Compound units, density and pressure
templates.text: A block weighs [[F]] N and rests on a face of area [[A]] m² or a face of area [[A * 2]] m². Work out the pressure on each face.

templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S4 Compound units, density and pressure
templates.text: Gold has density [[d]] g/cm³. A bar is [[l]] cm by [[w]] cm by [[h]] cm. Work out its mass in kg. (3 marks)

templates.subtopic: Rates of change from curved graphs
templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S5 Rates of change from curved graphs
templates.text: A curve passes through (2, [[a]]) and (4, [[b]]). Work out the gradient of the chord.

templates.subtopic: Rates of change from curved graphs
templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S5 Rates of change from curved graphs
templates.text: The gradient of a tangent to a distance-time graph at $t = [[t]]$ is [[v]]. What does it represent?
templates.answer: The speed at $t = [[t]]$ s is [[v]] m/s

templates.subtopic: Rates of change from curved graphs
templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S5 Rates of change from curved graphs
templates.text: A tangent to a curve is drawn through (1, [[a]]) and (5, [[b]]). Estimate the rate of change.

templates.subtopic: Rates of change from curved graphs
templates.source: Y11 Higher Spring B3 Rates · S5 Rates of change from curved graphs
templates.text: The depth of water is [[a]] cm at 2 min and [[b]] cm at 6 min. Estimate the average rate of change and say whether the instantaneous rate at 4 min is likely larger or smaller if the graph is a flattening curve. (3 marks)
templates.answer: Average [[(b - a) / 4|dp:2]] cm/min; the instantaneous rate at 4 min is likely larger than the average later and smaller than earlier ones as the curve flattens
